positions.title: Account Executive
positions.summary: Own the full commercial portfolio for the Central U.S. across pharma, biotech, and academic R&D. Manage technical sales from scientific discovery and workflow evaluation through funding, procurement, and close.
bullets: Achieved 111% of FY26 Q3, 115% of FY26 Q4, and 228% of FY27 Q1 targets.
Grew territory pipeline 10×, from $500K to $5M+.
Manage $400K+ opportunities and sales cycles extending beyond nine months across SPR, DSF, CD, HDX-MS, and stopped-flow.
First AE to close a cross-platform CD and SPR instrument sale following Nicoya’s acquisition of Applied Photophysics.

bullets: Rebuilt the OpenSPR pipeline to $1.465M in qualified opportunities.
Achieved 156% of the FY26 Q2 on-ramp target ($156K against $100K).
Created $3.4M in cross-sell pipeline through adjacent opportunities and collaboration with other AEs.

positions.title: SDR Team Lead

bullets: Generated $6.3M in self-sourced pipeline and $1.4M in influenced revenue.
Exceeded 125% of quota on instrument warranty sales.
Hired and mentored four SDRs and developed onboarding and prospecting playbooks.
Automated conference lead capture and enrichment in JavaScript, saving approximately 10 hours per event.

bullets: Ranked #1 at 113.6% of meeting quota; sourced $1.1M+ in influenced revenue and secured 40+ prospect meetings.
Exceeded lead-generation targets by 50%+ at North American and EMEA industry conferences.

positions.title: Sales Development Representative

bullets: Ranked third in North American ACV in Q2 and Q3 2022, and first in QSLs in Q3 2022.
Consistently maintained the highest monthly activity.
